title: Keep every item on track
description: One shared list for what your team has to do, who owns it and where it stands. Set it up in minutes.

props.title: Keep every item on track
props.subtitle: One shared list for what your team has to do, who owns it and where it stands. No status meeting needed to find out.

image.alt: The list of items, each with its owner and its status
image.prompt: A clean product screenshot: a list of work items with owner and status columns, on a light background

props.title: Everything the team needs to follow the work
props.subtitle: Nothing to configure before the first item is in.

items.title: One list, always current
items.text: Every item has an owner, a status and a date. What changes shows up for everyone at once.

items.title: Made for the whole team
items.text: Invite colleagues with a link. Each of them sees what is theirs first.

items.title: Quiet by default
items.text: You are told when something of yours moves, and only then.

items.title: Found in a second
items.text: Search by title, owner or status, and keep the filters you use every day.

items.title: Yours, and private
items.text: Your data stays in your workspace. Export it whenever you want.

items.title: Fast on every screen
items.text: The same list on a phone as on a desk, without an app to install.

props.title: Up and running in three steps
props.subtitle: From an empty list to a team that knows what comes next.

items.title: Create your workspace
items.text: Name it, and you are in. No card, no setup call.

items.title: Add your first items
items.text: Type them in, or paste a list: one line becomes one item.

items.title: Invite the team
items.text: Share the link. Everyone picks up what is theirs.

items.question: How long does it take to get started?
items.answer: A few minutes. Create a workspace, add an item, and the list is ready to share.

items.question: Can I bring an existing list?
items.answer: Yes. Paste it in: each line becomes an item you can then assign and date.

items.question: Who can see my items?
items.answer: Only the people you invite to the workspace. Nothing is public.

items.question: Does it work on a phone?
items.answer: Yes. The site adapts to the screen, and nothing has to be installed.

props.title: Start with your first item
props.text: It takes less time than writing the status update.
One shared list for the work of a team.
